name: RGPhi: Rational radix-Mobius dynamics research compendium
description: Exact research compendium for a noncommutative rational semigroup generated by an integer-radix map and a Mobius-conjugate branch. Includes a submission-grade paper on robust nonnested extremal targets, exact threshold data, finite modular trap classification, software, tests, and reproducibility metadata.

affiliation.name: Centro de Estudios del Sur (CEDESUR), Universidad Nacional Arturo Jauretche

citation.name: Nonnested extremal targets in a rational radix-Mobius semigroup
